==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace the "issue number" and "story name" with the appropriate information.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>Starlog|''ISSUE NUMBER''|STORY NAME|''FORMATTED NAME'' (optional)|LINK}}

===Example===
<code><nowiki>{{Starlog|337|Starlog (magazine)|New Hopes}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Starlog|337|Starlog (magazine)|New Hopes}}
